sheets.name: permit_register
sheets.notes: All cost figures are illustrative ranges only for learning structure. Never pay from illustrative figures. Verify every fee and form with the issuing agency and enter verified fees with dates. Totals are formula sums. Illustrative rows only.

sheets.name: timeline_planner
sheets.notes: Quoted lead times are entered only after agency confirmation with verification dates in the tracker. Parallel items run together; sequential items stack. Typical full-stack planning context is 4 to 10 weeks; your case depends on backlog and readiness. Illustrative rows only.

sheets.name: application_tracker
sheets.notes: Log filings the same day with receipt numbers and follow-up dates. Never leave a pending row without a next date. Record inspector names, results, and corrections factually. Receipt numbers shown are illustrative only.

sheets.name: renewal_calendar
sheets.notes: Alert date equals expiration minus lead time minus buffer by formula. Review monthly, weekly within 30 days of expiration. One row per approval per jurisdiction. Illustrative dates only.
